 Fresh To You Biscuit Sandwiches Recall For Listeria Expands
 November 18, 2026 by Linda Larsen 
 The Fresh to You biscuit sandwiches and Mmm! Meals Made in Minutes biscuit sandwiches recalls for possible Listeria monocytogenes contamination has been expanded to include more expiration dates and a new product. No illnesses have been reported to the company to date in connection with the consumption of these products. The recalling firm is Fresh & Ready Foods of Longview, Texas.
 This recall was expanded because the C.H. Guenther & Son’s recall of biscuit products for possible Listeria contamination was expanded. You can see more pictures of the recalled items at the FDA web site. 
 The recalled items were distributed between October 15, 2026 and November 11, 2026 through employee break rooms, Grab & Go coolers, refrigerated vending machines, and micro-markets. The recalled products include Fresh To You Sausage, Egg & Cheese Biscuit Sandwich that is packaged in a 5.7 ounce clear plastic film bag. The SKU number is 3100048, and the biscuits are Fresh Thru 11/12/26 to 11/22/26. The biscuits were sold in these states: Alabama, Arkansas,  Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Texas.
 Also recalled is Mmm! Meals Made in Minutes Biscuit & Sausage Gravy, that is packaged in a 9.5  ounce clear plastic clamshell. The SKU number for this product is 90013, and the Fresh Thru dates are 11/12/2026 to 11/18/2026. The biscuits were sold in these states: Alabama,  Louisiana, Mississippi, Oklahoma, Tennessee, and Texas.
 If you purchased these products, do not eat them. You can throw them away in a secure trash can with a tight fitting lid after first double bagging them so others can’t see them. If you want a refund, contact Fresh & Ready Foods by email.
 If you ate these sandwiches, monitor your health for the symptoms of listeriosis for the next 70 days. If you do get sick, see your doctor.
